FinalizedResume.title: Finalized Resume
FinalizedResume.description: A record of a finalized resume with its metadata and job description.

fullName.description: The full name of the person on the resume.

editorName.description: The name of the person who redid the resume.

finalizedAt.description: The date and time the resume was finalized.

jobDescriptionUrl.description: A link to the job description used.

jobDescriptionText.description: The text of the job description used for searching.

resumeName.description: The name given to this resume version.

version.description: The version number of the resume.

uid.description: The UID of the user who saved this resume.
